## Football effect

Trawick played all 60 defensive snaps at safety next to Rambo and five on the kicking game, with eight tackles, seven solo, and a pass defended, the incompletion for Antonio Brown at 0:45 of the second quarter. Three of the tackles came on the drive at the end of which the injury was logged: Bell's 2-yard run on second-and-6, Blount's 6-yard run on third-and-4 and, shared with Daryl Smith, Roethlisberger's 3-yard scramble on second-and-8. After it he was on the field for the three kneel-downs that ended the game. On the projection he is out through Friday, October 10, and back on Saturday, October 11, the day before the Week 6 game at Tennessee; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Prosinski is the safety reserve and the sixth defensive back on the chart, Phillips the next safety. No role change follows from the instruction; the Week 6 safety pairing and inactives are Stone's after the October 7 reassessment, and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
